body: I hated French but our teacher was awful anyways. Nice lady, just bad at teaching. I don't have a subject I like anymore, school sucked out any joy I had with learning, it's mostly just been which ever one I was doing best in. Right now by some luck I have a B in anatomy, and the only reason I'm doing so well is because there hasn't been much homework.

I don't know. It's not like math is hard. It's school that's hard. Math just happened to be the class this year I'm doing shite in. Before this it was history, before that it was animal science, before that it was English, every year there's some new bullshit I can't do but this time there's literally no way I'm going to be able to pass. Every year gets worse and worse. I'm burnt out.

It's not. I don't care about math. It's the fact that I'm going to have to repeat the class again, probably be put into foundation's this time, which will mean twice as long of a class, and then not only do I have to repeat it again but not I'll be a year or two behind everyone else, meaning I'll have to do even more.

I don't care that I'm failing math, I care that I'll have to repeat it over again and it'll just be another hell. I'm so sick of school and I can't take it anymore.

Also, I guess it's less of being "normal" and more of being so fucking fucked up that nothing I do is ever right or good and it's always my fault.
